ann.t: Copy of Newspaper Publication — Visaka Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Newspaper Publication of Audited Financial Statement (Standalone & Consolidated) for the second quarter and half ended September 30, 2026
Outcome of Board Meeting — Visaka Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Visaka Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Adoption of new line(s) of business — The Board of Directors of the Company in its meeting held on August 06, 2026 approved setting up of manufacturing of Construction Chemicals line at Company's AC unit at Tumkur, Karnataka.

Capacity addition — The Board of Directors of the Company held on August 06, 2026 approved capacity expansion of fibre cement boards and calcium silicate boards by 72,000 MT PA by setting up of new plant at Tonk, state of Rajasthan at an estimated capex of Rs. 175 Crore.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Visaka Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP

Corrigendum — Visaka Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Corrigendum to submission dt. July 10, 2026 in regard to update on legal disputes. In that letter date of earlier submissions was inadvertently typed as 25-11-2026 instead of 25-11-2025.
